Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing multiple patents for next-generation wireless communication is a high-stakes move designed to secure a temporary monopoly on specific technologies. This legal maneuver poses a significant threat to our business by potentially blocking our current development pathways, forcing us to either invest heavily in licensing agreements or pivot to alternative, possibly less efficient, technical solutions. This could delay our time-to-market and increase R&D costs, thereby impacting our competitive edge in the wireless communications sector.

Regarding your priority question: A book is primarily made of paper.
